description: This file is a C header file (`json_util.h`) defining functions, macros, and external references related to JSON utilities, including memory debugging, string manipulation, and version compatibility. It provides interface declarations for JSON processing in C, intended to be included in source files that implement or use JSON functionality.

methods.name: json_split
methods.description: Splits a JSON string into parts based on some delimiter (functionality assumed from name).

methods.name: json_dumps_static
methods.description: Serializes a JSON object to a static buffer with flags; for JSON dump operations.

methods.name: json_gets
methods.description: Extracts a string value from a JSON object safely into a buffer.

methods.name: json_get_str
methods.description: Gets a string value from a JSON object directly into a buffer.

methods.name: json_memdbg_init
methods.description: Initializes JSON memory debugging within an event loop.

methods.name: json_memdbg_free
methods.description: Frees memory allocated during JSON debugging.

methods.name: json_memdbg_get_stats
methods.description: Retrieves statistics about JSON memory allocations.

methods.name: json_memdbg_report
methods.description: Reports JSON memory debug info, optionally only differences.

methods.name: void json_free(void * p)
methods.description: Frees memory allocated by JSON dump functions, using custom allocators.
